w10_P4_003647: A forklift on a warehouse floor pushes a pallet of mass 128000 g. The pallet's acceleration, in m/s², is 5 times a, where a is the smaller of the two values satisfying a² − 7a + 10 = 0. The forklift's mast is 3.2 m tall. Express the push required for that acceleration in kN. The warehouse operates 5 identical forklifts pushing identical pallets at once. What is their combined push, in kN?
w10_P4_003650: The result the lab wants is a signed net force in kN, forward positive: a probe's forward force converted to kN, minus a 14 kN retarding clamp. The probe has a mass of 2 kg and sits on a bench 1.6 m wide. Its acceleration, in m/s², is 11 times the largest whole number that divides both 206 and 325 with no remainder. The forward force is what is needed to produce that acceleration, plus a 4 N push from a spring. What is the net signed force, in kN?
w10_P4_003655: A trolley of mass 87000 g is pushed with an acceleration a, in m/s², where a is the smaller of the two values satisfying a² − 10a + 16 = 0. The push needed for that acceleration is increased by 7 N for castor friction and then by 20 N for a ramp. The trolley's handle is 0.9 m high. 11 identical trolleys are pushed this way and their pushes are added, and then an 8 N reading offset is added. What is the final figure, in N?
w10_P4_003673: The figure required is a total force in kN over 2 identical shifts, each shift running 9 identical lines, each line pushing 12 identical crates. A crate has a mass of 65 kg and is 0.6 m wide. It starts with zero acceleration at t = 0 s, and its acceleration grows at a rate of 3t² + 2t, in m/s³, with t in seconds, until t = 1 s. The force on one crate is what is needed to give it the acceleration reached at t = 1 s, expressed in kN. What is the total force, in kN?
w10_P4_003678: The number a workshop needs is a final energy in kJ: a flywheel disc's energy of motion less 8 J of bearing loss, converted to kJ, plus 1 kJ from a starter motor. The disc has a mass of 22 kg and a rim speed, in m/s, equal to 5 times the sum of 9 and 6, less 27. The disc is 0.4 m in diameter. What is the final energy, in kJ?
w10_P4_003689: A cart of mass 25000 g starts with zero acceleration at t = 0 s, and its acceleration grows at a rate of 2t² + 8t, in m/s³, with t in seconds, until t = 3 s. The bench is 2.0 m long. The force on the cart is what is needed to give it the acceleration reached at t = 3 s; express it in kN and take it as positive. 8 identical carts are pushed together and their forces added, after which an 8 kN retarding force and then a 29 kN braking force act against them. What is the resulting signed net force, in kN?
w10_P4_003707: The figure a launch crew wants is a final energy in kJ: the energy of motion of 9 identical capsules, converted to kJ, minus 29 kJ spent on separation charges, plus 13 kJ recovered by a brake. Each capsule has a mass of 40000 g and moves at a speed, in m/s, equal to the number of ways of choosing 4 seats out of 7. Find one capsule's energy first and scale to the 9 capsules before converting. What is the final energy, in kJ?
w10_P4_003710: A skateboard of mass 52 kg on the test bench moves at a speed v, in m/s, where v is the larger of the two values satisfying v² − 3v + 2 = 0. The board's deck is 0.8 m long. To its energy of motion add 18 J from a push, then 14 J from a second push. 7 identical boards are treated this way and their energies added, then 13 J from a final nudge is added. What is the total, in J?
w10_P4_003715: A cargo lift accelerates a crate of mass 156 kg at a rate, in m/s², equal to the number of ways of choosing 2 items from 11, plus 19. The lift shaft is 40 m high. The lift force beyond the crate's weight is what is needed for that acceleration; 17 N of it is lost to guide friction, and the remainder is expressed in kN. 8 identical lifts are run together. What is the combined force, in kN?
w10_P4_003718: The value to find is a net signed force in kN, forward positive: a rover's drive force converted to kN, minus a 22 kN retarding tether pull. The rover has a mass of 122000 g. Its commanded acceleration, in m/s², is numerically 25 more than the speed in m/s it reaches at t = 2 s, having started from rest at t = 0 s with an acceleration of 3t² + 6t, in m/s² with t in seconds, from t = 0 s to t = 2 s. The drive force is what is needed to produce the commanded acceleration. What is the net signed force, in kN?
w10_P4_003720: The number the yard wants is a total in kN: the combined pull on 2 identical wagons in kN, plus a 5 kN reserve, plus another 5 kN reserve. Each wagon has a mass of 126 kg and is given an acceleration, in m/s², equal to the sum of the terms 2k − 1 for k running from 1 to 6. The pull on one wagon is the force needed for that acceleration, expressed in kN. What is the total, in kN?
w10_P4_003726: A go-kart of mass 32000 g travels at a speed, in m/s, equal to the number of ways of choosing 2 corners out of the 10 on the circuit. From its energy of motion subtract 21 J lost to tyre scrub, and express the result in kJ. 4 identical karts race together and their results are added, after which 12 kJ consumed by the pit heater is subtracted. What is the final figure, in kJ?
w10_P4_003730: The figure a haulage firm needs is a total force in kN for 11 identical trucks, each truck's figure being its net drive force in kN plus an 8 kN trailer preload. A truck has a mass of 185 kg on the scale-model rig and is 1.5 m long. Its acceleration a, in m/s², is the larger of the two values satisfying a² − 4a + 3 = 0; the drive force is what is needed for that acceleration, and 25 N of it is lost to rolling resistance to give the net drive force. What is the total, in kN?
w10_P4_003733: A crane trolley of mass 47000 g moves so that its velocity along the beam is 1t³ + 2t² m/s, with t in seconds. The force on the trolley is what is required to give it its acceleration at t = 2 s; express it in kN. A gantry carries 8 such trolleys, and the yard has 11 such gantries. What is the total force, in kN?
w10_P4_003737: A small drone of mass 9000 g starts with zero acceleration at t = 2 s, and its acceleration grows at a rate of 4t² + 1t, in m/s³, with t in seconds, until t = 3 s. The thrust needed is what gives the drone the acceleration reached at t = 3 s. A pod carries 5 such drones, a rack holds 4 such pods, and the hangar has 5 such racks. What is the total thrust, in N?
w10_P4_003753: A lift carriage of mass 184 kg has position 4t³ + 4t² metres in its shaft, with t in seconds. The shaft is 60 m tall. The cable force beyond the carriage's weight is what is needed to give it its acceleration at t = 3 s; express it in kN. A hoist drives 4 such carriages, and a 7 kN brake preload is added to the hoist's total. The building has 8 such hoists. What is the combined force, in kN?
w10_P4_003756: The value wanted is a net signed force in kN, forward positive: the combined net force of 3 identical rams, converted to kN, minus a 26 kN retarding load. Each ram pushes a block of mass 70000 g at an acceleration, in m/s², equal to the number of ways of choosing 2 dies out of 10. The ram's stroke is 0.3 m. The force on the block is what is needed for that acceleration, and 30 N of it is lost to seal friction, leaving the ram's net force. What is the net signed force, in kN?
w10_P4_003774: A puck of mass 22000 g starts from rest at t = 2 s, and from t = 2 s to t = 3 s its acceleration, in m/s², is 2t² + 7t with t in seconds. The air table is 1.8 m long. Take the puck's energy of motion at its speed at t = 3 s. A tray holds 10 pucks and the lab uses 4 trays, all launched identically. To the combined energy add 12 J from a spring and then 19 J from a magnetic kick. What is the total, in J?
w10_P4_003778: A test buggy of mass 21 kg starts from rest at t = 0 s, and from t = 0 s to t = 1 s its acceleration, in m/s², is 4t² + 8t with t in seconds. At t = 1 s a booster multiplies its speed by 5. Take the buggy's energy of motion at the boosted speed, then add 14 J from a flywheel, then 19 J from a spring, then 12 J from a capacitor. What is the resulting energy, in J?
w10_P4_003782: A conveyor pushes bins, each of mass 155000 g, with an acceleration, in m/s², equal to 4 times a, where a is the larger of the two values satisfying a² − 12a + 35 = 0. The belt runs at 40 °C. The force on one bin is what is needed for that acceleration. A section pushes 8 bins, and the plant has 11 sections; the combined force is increased by 29 N from a tensioning spring. What is the resulting force, in N?
w10_P4_003786: The number to find is a total force in N over 12 identical trains, each of 6 identical wagons. Each wagon has a mass of 151 kg. Its acceleration, in m/s², is 10 times the value of 2 times the sum of 2 and 1. The force on one wagon is what is required for that acceleration. What is the total force, in N?
w10_P4_003787: A test sled of mass 54000 g runs at a speed, in m/s, equal to 5 times the sum of 6 and 7. The rail is 120 m long. From its energy of motion subtract 4 J of rail friction. 8 identical sleds are run in a set, and 4 sets are run; add up the energy over all sleds and express it in kJ. What is the total, in kJ?
w10_P4_003791: A lab trolley of mass 36000 g is accelerated at a rate, in m/s², equal to the largest whole number that divides both 120 and 110 with no remainder. The trolley's bench is at 20 °C. The force on it is what is needed for that acceleration. A rack pushes 12 such trolleys and there are 3 racks; express the combined force in kN and then add an 11 kN clamp force. What is the total, in kN?
w10_P4_003795: A test car of mass 57000 g has position 1t³ + 3t² metres along the track, with t in seconds. Take the car's energy of motion at its speed at t = 4 s. A heat runs 3 such cars; add their energies and add 1 J for the timing beacon. 4 identical heats are run, and the total is expressed in kJ. What is the total, in kJ?
w10_P4_003798: A cart of mass 114000 g starts with zero acceleration at t = 0 s, and its acceleration grows at a rate of 4t² + 6t, in m/s³, with t in seconds, until t = 1 s. The cart is 0.7 m long. The force on it is what is needed to give it the acceleration reached at t = 1 s. A line pushes 10 carts, the plant has 4 lines, and a 22 N spring force is added to the combined force. What is the resulting force, in N?
